DrugFdaSort.description: Drugs@FDA application order; omitted keeps the source's own order.

DrugNameSelector.description: One explicit ChEMBL name filter without fallback or synonym expansion.
x-enum-descriptions: Match the native preferred name exactly, ignoring case.
Match an explicit native synonym exactly, ignoring case.

DrugRecallClassification.description: FDA's native recall classification, with no local ranking.

LabelApplicationType.description: An openFDA label's FDA application type, read from the prefix of openFDA's application_number.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search one drug source. FDA drug recalls accept a name or native firm, classification, status, reason and initiation dates; counts are recall records. WHO prequalification accepts a name, area or date range. openFDA labels also accept literal indication or mechanism wording. Drugs@FDA accepts a name or applicant. FDA signals take a drug or report text. FDA withdrawals take a drug, indication or withdrawal date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Purple Book takes a proprietary name, proper name or BLA.

applicant.description: Case-insensitive sponsor_name prefix. Matches listed sponsors. A drug name narrows results.

application_type.description:
Filter by application type. For example, nda,bla excludes; help search drug
Filter by application type. For example, nda,bla excludes generics (ANDA).

approved_from.description: Earliest original_approval (inclusive, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Counts matches in range.

approved_to.description: Latest original_approval. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

classification.description:
FDA recall classification; help search drug
FDA recall classification.

exact_term.description: Use only typed text. Name widening applies to labels, Drugs@FDA, FDA recalls and safety communications, and EMA.

expand_drug_names.description: Accepted for one release. Name widening is already automatic where supported.

firm.description: Exact phrase in the published recall firm name.

indication.description: Exact Indications and Usage wording. No disease synonyms. Drug names narrow results.

limit.description: Rows per page. Purple Book product summaries always return the full roster.

mechanism_of_action.description: Exact Mechanism of Action wording. No synonyms or drug class inference.

name_selector.description:
ChEMBL name to match. Default: preferred name; help search drug
ChEMBL name to match. Default: preferred name.

name_snapshot.description: Reuse the first page’s name token with unchanged filters.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Purple Book applies this only to presentation rows.

prequalified_from.description: First WHO prequalification date. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

prequalified_to.description: Last WHO prequalification date. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

presentations.description: Return presentation rows, as do --strength and --device.

query.description:
Drug name or text. FDA signals match report text. FDA withdrawals match indications or dates (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).
Optional for safety communications or with recall, WHO, label or applicant filters.
Labels and Drugs@FDA try exact names, then words. Labels also search label text.
Recall aliases keep display names.
Safety communications match titles, linked names and text.
Zero matches does not establish that FDA issued no communication about this drug.
FDA index: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/drug-safety-communications

sort.description:
Drugs@FDA order. newest uses the latest submission status; help search drug
Drugs@FDA order. newest uses the latest submission status date, including supplements.
original-approval uses original_approval. Recent first, then application number, with undated last. Default: FDA order.

source.description:
Drug source. An empty name search may retry names from other; help search drug
Drug source. An empty name search may retry names from other sources.

strength.description: FDA presentation strength. Ignores case and spaces.

therapeutic_area.description: WHO therapeutic area. Match whole words, ignoring case (e.g. Oncology).

title: DrugSearch
